serving_info.readout: native next-token logits restricted to option letters, argmax (ties -> first)

champion.rule: mean over games of the paired per-seed win rate vs the 3 external competitors; ties: sum RMST<=60, then mean level at failure, then NAGI order
champion.caveat: best-of-4 selection: the champion's numbers are optimistic (winner's curse); champion-vs-others margins are a screen, not confirmatory; confirmation needs fresh seeds
